name: Petty Cash — Monthly
query:
SELECT
  YEAR(pce.dated) AS `Year`,
  MONTH(pce.dated) AS `Month No`,
  MONTHNAME(pce.dated) AS `Month`,
  pce.account AS `Account`,
  SUM(pce.amount) AS `Amount`
FROM `tabPetty Cash Entry` pce
WHERE pce.docstatus < 2
  AND (%(year)s IS NULL OR %(year)s = '' OR YEAR(pce.dated) = %(year)s)
  AND (%(month)s IS NULL OR %(month)s = '' OR MONTH(pce.dated) = %(month)s)
GROUP BY YEAR(pce.dated), MONTH(pce.dated), pce.account
ORDER BY YEAR(pce.dated) DESC, MONTH(pce.dated) DESC
